assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, setbacks, road redlines), ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.
assumptions.why: 官方控规条件（容积率、建筑高度、密度、退线、道路红线）未包含在已清权 site package 中（见 planning_limits.json）。
assumptions.how_to_resolve: 官方控规附件或正式设计条件发布后，在 metrics.json 中把 floor_area_ratio/building_density 等 unknown 项复算为 known，并更新 proposal.md 对应章节。

assumptions.statement: All boundaries and key-area polygons are provisional_rough geometry from provisional_boundaries.geojson; they approximate official announced areas (site 11.4k㎡, key areas 368.4ha) within ~0.2-0.5% but are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Boundary- and area-sensitive statements are design discussion only; all area metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are published.
assumptions.why: 主办方未在公开数据包中发布官方 SITE_BOUNDARY/KEY_AREA polygon；skill 规定 organizer data gap 不阻塞内容评分。
assumptions.how_to_resolve: 官方 polygon 发布后替换 site_boundary.geojson/key_areas.geojson 并按 EPSG:4548 复算 metrics。

assumptions.statement: 8 个全球 AI 创新生态案例为背景性经验参照，基于公开报道与研究资料整理，不构成投资、政策或实施承诺。
assumptions.impact: 案例结论仅作为概念建议与深化方向，不进入正式规划控制或指标声明。
assumptions.why: skill 要求 formal 主张必须依赖 formal-ready 来源或已清权附件；案例为背景资料。
assumptions.how_to_resolve: 如需正式引用，逐条核对原始公开来源并登记于 sources.json。

assumptions.statement: 12 张 AI 场景卡与 3 个测试验证场景均为概念建议，需人工复核、隐私合规与主管部门试点审批后方可落地。
assumptions.impact: 场景不表述为已批准运营或可全面部署的技术。
assumptions.why: skill 禁止把未成熟技术写成已可全面部署、把测试场景写成已批准运营。
assumptions.how_to_resolve: 进入试点时补充运营主体、数据合规与人工复核机制。

assumptions.statement: 实施分期（P1-P5）与更新项目清单为概念性建议，实体建设依赖控规、权属、资金与审批路径确认；运营活动可轻量先行。
assumptions.impact: 分期不作为已确定政府安排或实施承诺。
assumptions.why: skill 边界条款要求六项 agent 任务的空间设想均为概念建议。
assumptions.how_to_resolve: 正式实施时由专业团队与主管部门确认条件后调整分期。
